title: Fairy Tale: Return of Heroes
summary: A 3D adventure RPG for Android, built in three months for the KKSI Game Development competition.
overview: Fairy Tale was developed in three months for the KKSI Game Development competition organized by the Ministry of Education and Culture and the Directorate General of Vocational Education, with mentoring from Satriver Studio.
The game follows a hero fighting through multiple levels to rescue his wife from monsters. It was my first complete game-development experience.
contributions: Implemented skill-based attacks and player combat interactions.
Implemented enemy AI behavior for interaction and attacks.
Implemented character movement mechanics.
Built a minimap-based navigation system for locations and objectives.
Implemented healing mechanics and player-status UI.
Implemented story and objective dialogue presentation.
